title: Reported military clash with aliens at Dulce

tellings.quote: uh Leonard Stringfield talked to me about it and he said he'd heard three different versions.

plain: In the late 1970s, at Dulce, New Mexico, US military forces are said to have clashed with aliens. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels he heard about it from Leonard Stringfield, a researcher of crashed UFO stories, who told him he had heard three different versions of what happened. If true, it would mean an armed fight between the military and nonhuman beings on American soil.
